name: GitHub OAuth
description: GitHub OAuth App integration: code exchange, primary-email fetch, org-membership gate, AES-256-GCM stateless session cookie, and a root middleware that protects configured paths while still honouring AUTH_MODE=mock as a dev short-circuit.

questions.prompt: Restrict to GitHub org members? (comma-separated org names, leave blank for any)
Path prefixes the middleware should require auth for (comma-separated)?

checklist: Create an OAuth App at https://github.com/settings/developers
Set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET from the OAuth App settings
Set AUTH_MODE=real (or unset AUTH_MODE) — this template's middleware.ts overwrites auth-mock's dev middleware and runs real GitHub auth on protected paths
Keep AUTH_MODE=mock for local dev — both the middleware and getCurrentUser() short-circuit to MOCK_USER
If using GITHUB_ALLOWED_ORGS, ensure the token has read:org scope
Verify GET /api/auth/me returns UserContext after login
Verify POST /api/auth/logout/github clears the session cookie
Confirm middleware redirects unauthenticated requests to /api/auth/login/github for paths under {protected_paths}
Use getCurrentUser() / requireAuth() in Server Components and Server Actions
